g.text: Sequence Diagram - Prepare, Issue and Send an Invoice (UC-05, UC-19, UC-20; FR2.3, FR2.4, FR2.6, FR2.7)
enters lines, quantities, prices, discounts and taxes
shows totals, taxes and due date
edits. A draft has no number yet.
[invalid data, missing approval or closed period]
shows number, PDF and delivery status
The final result (delivered or failed) arrives later from the provider through
receiveDeliveryReport (UC-20 steps 7-8). A failed sending never changes the
issued invoice or its number (FR2.7.4); the invoice can be resent (FR2.7.5).
